ns0:svg.ns0:title: Janeway Hero Board — editable SVG
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: 4500 × 2700 px Janeway board. SVG icon geometry and editable text positioned against the approved raster hero-board composition. Original source artwork remains raster; all rules icons are vector.

and never abandon a member of your crew.”
